description: Source code for the Work Order doctype in ERPNext manufacturing module, including class definitions, methods for validation, calculation, and document management related to manufacturing work orders.

classes.name: WorkOrder
classes.description: Class representing a manufacturing work order, with methods for validation, calculation, status updates, and document management.

methods.description: Loads manufacturing settings and sets onload properties.
